title: Setups page is cluttered: it repeats every setup's alignment, work offset, workholding and tool list - keep only the setup list and New setup

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
Reported by the maintainer in chat (2026-11-12, v0.18.0, with a screenshot), filed by an agent for him.

**What he sees.** With one setup and a fixture plate in the document, selecting **Setups** in the browser fills the Properties pane with, top to bottom: the `Setup1 (active)` row and its Delete; "stock Stock, WCS not placed"; **Part alignment** (As modelled, Turn X/Y/Z about ... Apply); "Lay on a plane - pick a face" and "pick three points" with their plane and checkboxes; the 3-2-1 frame box; "Axes in the plane" with the +Y / +X edge and two-point rows; **Work offset**; then "Carry stock and WCS over" + New setup; then "Workholding in this setup's collision checks" with the whole fixture plate block (Place, Locate part, Unmark, Delete, the plate and dowel rows, Add mod vise pair, Import fixture, Add built-in vise, Add accessory, Add fixture plate); then the tool list and Export setup sheets. Every further setup stacks another alignment block on top.

His words: "The upper part associated with 'setup 1' should only be seen under 'Setup 1'. but we can keep a list with the delete button and the 'new setup' section - but remove all the part alignment on the 'Setups' properties, and keep them on the 'Setup<n>' properties.. this to declutter it.. A lot."

**Decided (maintainer, question dialog, same day): "Remove them too"** - the workholding block and the tool list also leave the Setups page.

**What is wanted**
The **Setups** page shows only:
- the list of setups: name (click to activate, as today), "(active)", the one status line (stock, WCS placed or not, datum from), and Delete;
- the New setup row ("Carry stock and WCS over" + New setup);
- Export setup sheets as one button at the bottom (it is about all setups: one page per setup).

Everything about ONE setup stays on that setup's own page, where it already is (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_pages.rs`: alignment, lay-on-plane, three points, axes, work offset, workholding, tool list). Nothing is lost, only the duplicate on `setups_page` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`, the `setup_*_pick` calls in the per-name loop and the `fixtures_section` / `tool_list_section` calls after it) goes.

**Keep**
- A document with NO setups has no Setup<n> node to hold these: its Setups page keeps "Create first setup" and the workholding and tool list of the implicit context, as today.
- A way from the list to a setup's page (e.g. the name selects/activates as today; if a second control is needed to open the Setup<n> page, say which in the PR).
- No command changes: every control that stays or moves still queues the same undoable command.

Done means: with two setups and a fixture plate, the Setups page holds the two rows with Delete, the New setup row and Export setup sheets, and no "Part alignment", "Lay on a plane", "Axes in the plane", "Work offset" or "Workholding" text; each Setup<n> page still holds all of them; the no-setup document is unchanged. Pinned in the structural tests (labels present and absent on each page), no snapshot PNG touched.
